notes.title: Under the Disco Lights Next-Fest GamePlay
notes.content: [p]🎤 [b]Live on Stream: Under the Disco Lights![/b] 🕺✨[/p][p]Are you ready? During Steam Next Fest, the lights are shining, the music is pumping, and we’re diving into the neon-soaked world of the 80s! In this special livestream, we’ll be playing our brand new narrative indie game [b]Under the Disco Lights[/b] for the very first time.[/p]
